zh: 离开旧址近十年后，美国金融博物馆向公众敞开了新的大门。

title: ‘We were stunned’: My daughter, 39, said her mother-in-law gives her more money than we do. Do I call her out?
title_zh: “我们都惊呆了”：我 39 岁的女儿说，她婆婆给她的钱比我们多。我叫她出来吗？
text: “She thanked us for the $100 birthday gift and then announced that her mother-in-law had sent her $400.”
zh: “她感谢我们送给她 100 美元的生日礼物，然后宣布她的婆婆给她寄了 400 美元。”

text: “He lived rent-free, helping her with health-related issues and other tasks.”
zh: “他免租居住，帮助她解决与健康相关的问题和其他任务。”

text: Ford CEO Jim Farley told CNBC that the automaker has learned from its past quality and recall issues, which have hurt its earnings and stained its reputation.
zh: 福特首席执行官吉姆·法利 (Jim Farley) 告诉 CNBC，该汽车制造商已经从过去的质量和召回问题中吸取了教训，这些问题损害了其盈利并玷污了其声誉。

title: Trump’s Freedom 250 draws corporate sponsors with business before his administration
title_zh: 特朗普的“自由 250”在其执政之前吸引了企业赞助商和企业
text: Companies with federal interests — including Boeing, Lockheed Martin and Oracle — are sponsoring a Trump-aligned effort celebrating America’s 250th birthday.
zh: 与联邦利益相关的公司——包括波音、洛克希德·马丁和甲骨文——正在赞助一项与特朗普结盟的活动，庆祝美国 250 岁生日。

title: Amazon has deployed enough satellites to launch Leo service later this year
title_zh: 亚马逊已部署足够的卫星，将于今年晚些时候推出 Leo 服务
text: Leo will compete with SpaceX's Starlink, which had a four-year start over Amazon and has more than 10,000 satellites in its constellation.
zh: Leo 将与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 竞争，后者比亚马逊早了四年，其星座中拥有超过 10,000 颗卫星。

title: Manhattan luxury real estate sales hold firm despite fears of a 'Mamdani effect'
title_zh: 尽管担心“马姆达尼效应”，曼哈顿豪华房地产销售仍保持坚挺
text: A month after the passage of a tax on second homes in New York City, brokers and analysts said sales of luxury real estate remain strong.
zh: 纽约市第二套房税通过一个月后，经纪人和分析师表示，豪华房地产的销售仍然强劲。

title: American Express and Chase move luxury lounge wars beyond the airport
title_zh: 美国运通和大通将豪华休息室大战转移到机场之外
text: Credit card companies are increasingly offering access to lounges and perks at festivals and sporting events, often exclusively for premium cardholders.
zh: 信用卡公司越来越多地在节日和体育赛事期间提供休息室和福利，通常专门针对高级持卡人。

title: Trump bought Apple, Nvidia and other tech giants before tariff reversal fueled rebound
title_zh: 特朗普在关税逆转推动反弹之前收购了苹果、英伟达等科技巨头
text: The day before President Donald Trump walked back his tariff policy turned out to be one of his busiest days of 2025 for stock buying.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统收回关税政策的前一天是他 2025 年股票购买最繁忙的日子之一。

title_zh: 技术下载：亚马逊设备主管 Panos Panay 谈科技巨头的人工智能设备推广
text: CNBC's Arjun Kharpal sits down Amazon's Panay on the latest episode of The Tech Download podcast.
zh: CNBC 的 Arjun Kharpal 在最新一集的 The Tech Download 播客中与亚马逊的 Panay 进行了对话。

title_zh: 避风港的表现不再像以前那样了。这是更改的内容
text: Traditional safe-haven assets — U.S. Treasurys, the Japanese yen and gold — have struggled to provide protection during this year’s market volatility.
zh: 传统避险资产——美国国债、日元和黄金——在今年的市场波动中难以提供保护。

title: Olympian David Hearn indicted in Reflecting Pool destruction of property case

text: President Donald Trump has made the renovation of the Reflecting Pool on the National Mall a top priority in his second year back in the White House.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统将翻新国家广场倒影池作为他入主白宫第二年的首要任务。

title: Levi's, The North Face and Columbia are turning to women to fuel their next phase of growth
title_zh: Levi's、The North Face 和 Columbia 正在寻求女性来推动下一阶段的增长
text: Legacy apparel brands including VF Corp., Levi's, and Columbia are investing more heavily in women's products and marketing.
zh: VF Corp.、Levi's 和 Columbia 等传统服装品牌正在加大对女性产品和营销的投资。

title: Small cap-focused Russell 2000 becomes first U.S. benchmark to enter correction territory
title_zh: 以小盘股为主的罗素 2000 指数成为首个进入调整区间的美国基准指数
text: Small caps are especially sensitive to changes in oil prices and a slowdown in the economic cycle.
zh: 小盘股对油价变化和经济周期放缓尤其敏感。

title: Fed still expects to cut rates once this year despite spiking oil prices
title_zh: 尽管油价飙升，美联储仍预计今年降息一次
text: The central bank's so-called dot plot showed a median estimate of 3.4% for the federal funds rate, the same as at the end of last year.
zh: 央行所谓的点阵图显示，联邦基金利率的中值为3.4%，与去年年底相同。

title: Micron was started by a few guys in an Idaho basement. How it rose to be at the center of the AI boom.
title_zh: Micron 是由爱达荷州地下室的几个人创立的。它是如何成为人工智能热潮的中心的。
text: Memory chips were once seen as an unglamorous business, but Micron is betting AI will change the game for good.
zh: 内存芯片曾经被视为一项乏味的业务，但美光科技押注人工智能将永远改变游戏规则。

title: Am I better off claiming Social Security early and investing the money, or delaying until age 70?
title_zh: 我是尽早领取社会保障并进行投资，还是推迟到 70 岁才更好？
text: “I have a monthly pension worth $11,000 and Social Security income of $4,000.”
zh: “我每月有 11,000 美元的养老金和 4,000 美元的社会保障收入。”

title: A week of wild volatility for Korean stocks brought to a rousing finale by reports of Anthropic-Samsung deal
title_zh: Anthropic 与三星交易的报道给韩国股市一周的剧烈波动带来了令人兴奋的结局
text: While it’s still delivered a 164% return so far in 2026, the Korean stock market has shown signs of fatigue in recent months
zh: 尽管 2026 年迄今仍实现了 164% 的回报率，但韩国股市近几个月已显示出疲态迹象

title: 5 takeaways from President Donald Trump's interview with CNBC
title_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统接受 CNBC 采访的 5 个要点
text: The president defended his family's business and said he feels bad that the presidency creates a conflict of interest in any of his children's investments.
zh: 总统为其家族企业进行了辩护，并表示，他对总统任期给他孩子的任何投资造成利益冲突感到难过。

title: Gold prices set for first weekly rise in a month as investors scale back Fed rate hike bets
title_zh: 随着投资者缩减美联储加息押注，金价将出现一个月来首次周上涨
text: The metal was boosted as investors scaled back their bets on a looming rate hike.
zh: 由于投资者缩减了对迫在眉睫的加息的押注，金价受到提振。

title: Christine Lagarde leaves door open to early ECB exit, as she mulls French politics
title_zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德考虑法国政治，为欧洲央行提前退出敞开大门
text: The European Central Bank's Christine Lagarde has declined to rule out an early end to her term as president, as she mulls a foray into French politics.
zh: 欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德(Christine Lagarde)拒绝排除提前结束行长任期的可能性，因为她正在考虑进军法国政坛。

title: GE Vernova's gas turbines aren't the only way it's winning from the AI boom
title_zh: GE Vernova 的燃气轮机并不是其从人工智能热潮中获胜的唯一途径
text: Electrification secured $2.4 billion in data center equipment orders during the first quarter of 2026, beating the segment's total for all of 2025.
zh: 电气化在 2026 年第一季度获得了 24 亿美元的数据中心设备订单，超过了该领域 2025 年全年的订单总额。

title: Trump Accounts get a boost from employer contributions — Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are the latest to offer matching programs
title_zh: 特朗普账户因雇主缴款而增加——高盛和摩根士丹利是最新提供匹配计划的公司
text: The growing list of companies that will match contributions to Trump Accounts for their employees now includes Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.
zh: 现在，越来越多的公司将为员工提供与特朗普账户相匹配的捐款，其中包括高盛和摩根士丹利。

title: Berkshire shares trade lower even after Abel scores good marks at meeting, earnings jump
title_zh: 即使阿贝尔在会议上取得好成绩、盈利大幅增长，伯克希尔股价仍走低
text: Many in the investment community were reassured by Abel's firm grasp over Berkshire's sprawling enterprise.
zh: 阿贝尔对伯克希尔庞大企业的坚定控制让投资界的许多人感到放心。
